acceptanceCriteria: The maximum pools.json size implied by entry count, reason length and receipt cap is within the 1 MiB bound, enforced by a bound on reason length or per-entry size.
A test builds the worst case and shows writes still succeed or fail with a typed refusal before the file is written.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1523 (pools-1021u, V1-1750, PSR-V0-196). PSR-V0-196 caps operation receipts at 512 per write, which fixed the receipt growth (1,048,666 B measured before). Expected: every pool write stays within the 1 MiB pools.json bound. Actual: entry reason fields of up to 4,096 B each let a 256-entry pools.json reach 2.07 MB with no receipts, after which every pool write is refused.
title: pools.json still exceeds its 1 MiB bound from pool entry reason text alone (256 entries x 4,096 B reasons = 2.07 MB, no receipts)
